prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Pleasanton CA?
answer_verbatim:
I don’t have live access to current reviews, so I can’t name a single “best” Pleasanton salon right now. Do you mean spray tan (airbrush) or UV tanning (beds/booths)? Tell me that and I’ll tailor recommendations.

In the meantime, here’s a quick checklist to help you find the best local salon:

What to search for
- Google or Yelp: “spray tan Pleasanton” or “tanning salon Pleasanton”
- Filter by 4+ stars and read recent reviews (last 6–12 months)

What to look for in reviews
- Consistent, natural-looking results (no orange or patchy tans)
- Cleanliness and well-kept equipment
- Friendly, knowledgeable staff and good customer service
- Safety concerns—reports of burns or poor hygiene are red flags

Questions to ask a salon before booking
- Do you use a brand (e.g., Norvell, Versa, Mystic)? Can I see before/after photos?
- Are technicians certified for spray tans? Do you offer a patch test?
- How old are your tanning beds? What maintenance/cleaning is done between clients?
- Do you have single-use disposable liners for beds/booths?
- What is the price and do you offer packages/first-time discounts?

Safety and service tips
- For spray tans: exfoliate, avoid moisturizers or deodorant before the session, and follow aftercare for best fade
- For UV tanning: limit frequency, follow staff guidance, and consider tanning accelerators cautiously; consult your doctor if you have health concerns
- If you want a mobile or at-home spray tan, ask about technician experience and solution brand

If you want, tell me:
- spray or UV
- your Pleasanton ZIP or the neighborhood you prefer
and I’ll give a short, practical list of likely top options and what to check on each (I won’t be able to pull live reviews but I can suggest the best candidates and questions to ask).
